text:
maria: Heads-up — Acme HW reported a performance regression after driver 535.54 landed on our marketplace images. Repro on p3-large with BERT-int8: 3x latency increase. Looks cuBLAS-related.
sam: Ack. Any quick repro steps?
maria: Yes — image: gcr.io/redwood/rt-gpu:2026-03. Run:
```
python perf_test.py --model bert --batch 8 --dtype int8
```
Observed after driver bump. Kernel: 5.15, nvidia driver 535.54, cudnn 8.2. Logs show long cuBLAS algo selection + occasional kernel timeouts.
wei: Looping in vendor-eng to triage (cc vendor-eng).
vendor-eng: We see the same in our lab, thanks for the repro. Preliminary: cuBLAS heuristic changed for small batches; preparing a micro-patch.
heather: Do we want to pin driver in marketplace images to the previous 534.x now? That slows other updates but reduces customer impact.
lucas: Proposal: canary a pinned image (534.102) at 5% traffic, collect perf/telemetry for 2 hours, then 25%/50%/100% if green.
maria: Agreed. Also we should run test matrix across CUDA12.2/12.1 and ROCm paths — partners expect parity.
samir: I'll add ROCm partner contacts — we haven't validated ROCm after the recent stack bumps.
heather: Owners: samir (partner coord + ROCm), lucas (canary rollout), maria (repro/test vectors), vendor-eng (driver patch).
devops-bot: Deploy job queued: marketplace-image-canary-3532100000 (status: started) :rocket:
lucas: Build ETA ~2h. I'll post perf digests here.
vendor-eng: Quick note — the hotpatch will be a driver micro-release (535.55) that forces fallback to previous algo for small batches. Validating now on their CI.
maria: Dropping perf vectors and logs to /shared/partnerships/benchmarks (internal link) and sample trace snippets.
samir: For announcement planning: if we pin drivers in marketplace images we need a coordinated comms plan with marketplace partner & our marketing/comms. cc @comms
comms: Noted — keep this internal unless customer outages spike. We'll prep a customer-safe message template if needed.
lucas: Canary at 5% is green after baseline check. Latency back to expected within 15%. Rolling to 25% now.
maria: Great — when we reach 100% we'll publish a mitigation note in marketplace docs and mark the image as driver-pinned until vendor patch lands.
vendor-eng: Hotpatch 535.55 passed our CI and perf lab. We'll provide signed driver bundle for marketplace ingestion.
samir: ETA for signed bundle + marketplace push: 24-36h (depends on signing & distro windows).
heather: Confirm rollback plan if anything spikes during rollout.
lucas: Rollback playbook: tag previous image, swap routing rule, flush canary -> full rollback ~10 minutes.
maria: Thanks all — I'll draft a short incident summary/postmortem template after we close. :thumbsup:
